summary: Iteration 30 — Phase 1 Courier System regression (backend + frontend). BACKEND: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (test_iteration30_courier_phase1.py). Coverage: (a) regression smoke — items list/detail + /subs/me still healthy; (b) POST /delivery/quote zone matrix — Westlands→nairobi_inner 30000, Kitengela→nairobi_metro 90000, Mombasa→major_towns 50000, unknown Nairobi area→nairobi_outer 60000 (defensive default), free-delivery threshold at 2_000_000 cents → free_applied=true + fee_due=0 (but base fee_cents still exposed for UI), USD currency → supported=false + fee=0; (c) POST /payments/checkout INITIALIZATION-ONLY (live Paystack — never opened) — asserted 200 with checkout.paystack.com URL and read the pending mongo row for both door + pickup: door stores delivery_option='door' + delivery_zone_key='nairobi_inner' + delivery_fee_cents=30000 + total_charged_cents=item+fee; pickup stores delivery_option='pickup' + delivery_zone_key='cbd_pickup' + delivery_fee_cents=0. Pending orders deleted after each test; (d) 2nd rider accepting an already-accepted job returns 409 as expected (synthetic order+2nd rider registered/approved/cleaned); (e) seller /seller/orders/{id}/fulfillment action=acknowledge still transitions paid → in_fulfillment on a non-courier synthetic order. FRONTEND (viewport 390×844): (i) Buyer checkout delivery panel — LOGIN buyer@aurafit.com → item detail → size + Buy opens AddressPickerSheet: checkout-delivery-panel + checkout-delivery-door (Outer Nairobi · KSh 600) + checkout-delivery-pickup (KSh 0) + checkout-total-row all present. Toggling door↔pickup correctly updates total row (Item KSh 199 · Delivery KSh 600 → KSh 799 in door mode; Item KSh 199 · Delivery FREE → KSh 199 in pickup mode). Did NOT press CONTINUE TO PAY (live Paystack). (ii) Rider portal — direct-nav to /(courier) after login shows courier-greeting + Jobs board (active/open/empty states) + Earnings tab with today/pending/paid tiles (all KSh 0 — earlier smoke-test earnings were deleted by cleanup). (iii) Admin /admin/delivery — all 5 zones (nairobi_inner/outer/metro/major_towns/rest_of_kenya) rendered with editable KSh fee inputs + Save buttons; free-delivery threshold input=20000, platform pct=10. Edited nairobi_inner from 300→350, saved, reloaded → persisted, then restored to 300. (iv) Admin /admin/couriers — 6 rider cards rendered with approve/reject/pay controls (all currently APPROVED). BUG FOUND (P0): after login as courier, user is redirected to /(tabs) (buyer discover) instead of /(courier). Approved-rider portal is only reachable via direct URL. See action_items. BUG FOUND (P1): rider registration form submit does not fire (no /api/auth/register request goes out on click) — tried 3 different email formats + 3 click strategies (loop-prevention stop). All backend endpoints for the flow work via curl. Deprecation warnings still present (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) — carry-over from iterations 28–29.

ui_bugs.issue: Works correctly — no bug. Reported here only for coverage.

integration_issues.issue: app/(auth)/login.tsx submit only routes admin/seller/needsSellerOnboarding, everything else falls to /(tabs). Approved riders logging in via login screen land on the buyer Discover tab. Fix: add `if (u.role === 'courier') { router.replace('/(courier)'); return; }` before the seller/tabs branch. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx:60-68.

Tapping register-submit-btn while role='courier' on the /register form does NOT trigger a POST /api/auth/register (verified with page.on('request')/expect_response — no network call fires). Button is enabled+visible+has bounding box. Backend endpoint works via curl (created a rider fresh). Tried 3 email formats (.test rejected by Pydantic — expected — but .com also failed) and 3 click strategies (force, scroll-into-view+force, keyboard-tab-blur). Loop-prevention halt. Likely root cause: some client-side validation short-circuits OR AppButton onPress isn't wired for the courier branch. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx:90 (submit) + 305-310 (AppButton).

critical_code_review_comments: core/delivery.py::detect_zone correctly defaults unmatched Nairobi text to nairobi_outer (never undercharge) and everything else to rest_of_kenya. Verified with SomeUnknownArea in Nairobi → 60000.
core/delivery.py::quote_for_address returns fee_cents (base zone rate) AND fee_due_cents (0 when free_applied) — UI can show 'FREE' with strike-through pricing thanks to that split.
routers/delivery.py::accept_job uses an atomic update_one filter {id, status:'open'} + modified_count check — race-safe and returns 409 on conflict (verified by second-rider test).

routers/payments.py::checkout correctly stores delivery_option/delivery_fee_cents/delivery_zone_key/total_charged_cents on the pending order; amount_cents stays item-only so platform_fee_bps + seller_net_cents keep their historical semantics (fee doesn't leak into seller payout).
app/(auth)/login.tsx MISSING role='courier' branch — see action items.

rca_of_issue: P0 login-redirect: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx submit() checks u.role for 'admin' and 'seller' but has no branch for 'courier', so approved riders fall to /(tabs) (buyer discover). Fix is a single 3-line addition before the seller check (see action_items). P1 rider register submit: root cause not identified — Playwright click did not fire an /api/auth/register request in 3 attempts despite the AppButton being enabled+visible with a valid bounding box. Likely one of: (a) courier-specific client-side validation silently exits submit() without a toast, (b) AppButton onPress prop isn't attached for the courier variant, (c) a keyboard-avoiding scroll layer intercepts touches at that position. Backend endpoint is healthy (curl POST /api/auth/register with role='courier' returns a 200 + token). Main agent to add console.log in submit() around line 90 to pinpoint where it exits.
